T051 owns only activation/coordinator/runner/Program paths; those missing components are assigned to T053, T055, and T057. Implementation would either proceed with known failing paired tests or require a later GREEN task to satisfy another task author's RED.
findings.correction_outcome: Repartition the correction RED assertions so T050 covers only activation, capacity filling, drain, terminal exhaustion, and coordinator-owned composition that T051 can make green; T052/T053 cover claimed-packet and lease hydration; T054/T055 cover executor, dispatcher, committer, failure mapping, and reconciliation edges owned by T055; and T056/T057 exclusively cover provider health/probe composition. Alternatively redefine serial vertical slices and ownership so each RED has exactly one GREEN that can make the complete focused suite pass before the next production task. Keep the repaired filesystem-disjoint RED files and complete shared-GREEN serialization.

findings.location: T051 line 195 versus pass1-runtime-contracts.md line 126 and plan.md AD-14/test slices 10-11
findings.evidence: T051 instructs the coordinator to call ReconcileAsync exactly once after durable terminal exhaustion. The accepted runtime contract instead requires a ReconcileAsync Conflict to reload current state and retry only while the same exact drained terminal pair remains eligible. No correction RED injects or asserts this production-coordinator conflict route: T050 names drain-before-reconcile and terminal status, while T054 only checks that a reconciliation call edge exists. An implementation following T051 literally may stop after a recoverable version/concurrency conflict and leave an otherwise eligible terminal pair without its required deterministic reconciliation and truthful terminal handoff.
findings.correction_outcome: Change T050's production-capacity RED to inject a reconciliation Conflict and require a durable reload plus conditional retry only for the same exact drained terminal pair, with no retry after pause/failure/authorization or boundary drift. Change T051 to call ReconcileAsync as the single normal transaction, but reload and retry a Conflict exactly as the accepted runtime contract requires; remove the contradictory unqualified exactly-once wording.
